title: Bio page
subtitle: A page with your most important links to paste into your Instagram or TikTok bio.

intro.title: A page just for your bio
intro.description: Bring your most important links together on a page that looks like you. Paste the address into your Instagram bio, TikTok, or anywhere else — no need to squeeze everything into one link.

avatar.label: Profile photo
avatar.hint: JPEG, PNG or WEBP, up to 2MB.

removeDialog.title: Remove profile photo?
removeDialog.body: Your page goes back to showing the title's initial instead of the photo.

errors.invalidType: Upload a JPEG, PNG or WEBP image.
errors.tooLarge: The image must be at most 2MB.
errors.uploadGeneric: We couldn't upload the photo. Please try again.
errors.removeGeneric: We couldn't remove the photo. Please try again.

address.label: Page address
address.hint: Choose the domain your page gets published at.

handle.label: Handle
handle.hint: 3–30 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (not at the start or end).

title.label: Title
title.placeholder: Your name or your brand's name

bio.label: Bio
bio.placeholder: Say in a few words what people will find here.

isActive.label: Page is live
isActive.onHint: Anyone with the address can view your page.
isActive.offHint: The page goes offline — the address stops working until you turn it back on.

errors.handleFormat: Use only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. It can't start or end with a hyphen.
errors.titleRequired: Choose a title for the page.
errors.saveGeneric: We couldn't save your page. Please try again.

preview.noItems: Your links will show up here.

items.empty: You haven't added any links to your page yet.
items.limitReachedNotice: You've reached the 20-link limit for this page. Remove an existing link to add another.

removeDialog.title: Remove this link from the page?
removeDialog.body: It will stop showing on your bio page. You can add it back anytime.
